---
title: "US Airline Flight Performance Dashboard"
format: dashboard
server: shiny
---


```{r}
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(lubridate)
df <- read_csv("flight_data_2024_sample.csv") |> mutate(fl_date = ymd(fl_date), across(where(is.character), as.factor))
df$carrier <- case_when(df$op_unique_carrier == "9E" ~ "Endeavor Air",
                       df$op_unique_carrier == "AA" ~ "American Airlines",
                       df$op_unique_carrier == "AS" ~ "Alaska Airlines",
                       df$op_unique_carrier == "B6" ~ "JetBlue Airways",
                       df$op_unique_carrier == "DL" ~ "Delta Air Lines",
                       df$op_unique_carrier == "F9" ~ "Frontier Airlines",
                       df$op_unique_carrier == "G4" ~ "Allegiant Air",
                       df$op_unique_carrier == "HA" ~ "Hawaiian Airlines",
                       df$op_unique_carrier == "MQ" ~ "Envoy Air",
                       df$op_unique_carrier == "NK" ~ "Spirit Airlines",
                       df$op_unique_carrier == "OH" ~ "PSA Airlines",
                       df$op_unique_carrier == "OO" ~ "SkyWest Airlines",
                       df$op_unique_carrier == "UA" ~ "United Airlines",
                       df$op_unique_carrier == "WN" ~ "Southwest Airlines",
                       df$op_unique_carrier == "YX" ~ "Republic Airways")

small_df <- df
# Shown instead of a plot when the inputs leave no rows
empty_plot <- function() {
  plotly_empty() |>
    layout(title = list(text = "No flights match these inputs.", y = 0.5))
}
```

# Plots

## {.sidebar}

Flight delays and cancellations are a major worry among travelers, especially during the holiday season. This dashboards explores seasonality trends with flight cancellations and delays. Use the input below to change the plots here and the table on the **Data** page.


```{r}
dateRangeInput("dates", "Date Range",
               start = min(small_df$fl_date), end = max(small_df$fl_date),
               min = min(small_df$fl_date), max = max(small_df$fl_date))
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: Diversions by Carrier
plotlyOutput("p1")
```

```{r}
#| title: Arrival Delay by Carrier
plotlyOutput("p2")
```

# Data

```{r}
#| title: Data used in the plots (filtered by the inputs on the Plots page)
DTOutput("tbl")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
filtered <- reactive({
  small_df |>
    filter(fl_date >= input$dates[1], fl_date <= input$dates[2])
})

output$p1 <- renderPlotly({
  if (nrow(filtered()) == 0) return(empty_plot())
  p <- ggplot(
    filtered() |> filter(diverted == 1),
    aes(x = op_unique_carrier)) +
    geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
    labs(
      x = "Carrier",
      y = "Number of Diversions",
      title = "Flight Diversions by Carrier")
  ggplotly(p)
})

output$p2 <- renderPlotly({
  if (nrow(filtered()) == 0) return(empty_plot())
  p <- ggplot(
    filtered() |> filter(!is.na(arr_delay)),
    aes(x = op_unique_carrier, y = arr_delay)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue") +
    labs(x = "Airline",
         y = "Arrival Delay (minutes)",
         title = "Arrival Delay by Carrier") 
  ggplotly(p)
})

output$tbl <- renderDT({
  filtered() |>
    select(fl_date, carrier, origin, origin_city_name, dest, dest_city_name, dep_delay, arr_delay, cancelled, air_time, distance, carrier_delay, weather_delay, nas_delay, security_delay, late_aircraft_delay) |>
    datatable(options = list(pageLength = 10))
})
```
